name: micropython-debug-bridge
description: Direct MCP access to MicroPython devices over serial and OTA

interface.shortDescription: Control MicroPython MCUs over serial and local-network OTA.
interface.longDescription: Discovers and identifies multiple MicroPython devices, installs files over macOS serial or authenticated local-network OTA, monitors serial output, resets MCUs, and exposes structured runtime debugging through a local stdio MCP server.
interface.defaultPrompt: List the connected MicroPython serial devices and help me select one.
